laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'In' reads more naturally than 'by' for 'among/within' communities here; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'By latere boeregemeenskappe' (among those communities) is natural Afrikaans; 'in' is only a different preposition, so this is a lateral move that also risks a shade of meaning.

na_skrywer.voor: Die leier van 'n opperhoofskap, wat besluite vir sy mense neem.

na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real but slight, and this is a glossary definition, so the writer should reword it rather than a language agent.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'kos verbou' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'kos kweek' is wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'jou eie kos kweek' is natural Afrikaans, and 'verbou' can also mean 'rebuild', which may confuse a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat met hulle leier ongelukkig was
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In a written relative clause the finite verb goes to the end.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the verb is normal Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Standard written Afrikaans uses 'ophou om te' with an infinitive here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'opgehou bestaan' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal only adds words.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence speaks of 'hulle lewe' in the past and then switches to 'jy' in the present; matching the person and tense follows the pattern of the parallel line in 'Kos en beeste'.
